summary: Agent products expose session reset, compaction and side-conversation controls that can implement the policy. None determines the optimal switch point automatically; teams need outcome-linked session telemetry.

items.text: Claude Code context management: automatic compaction plus /compact and /clear give operators explicit continuation and reset controls.
Aider in-chat commands: /clear, /reset, /tokens and /save allow a session to be inspected, checkpointed or restarted deliberately.
Cursor Side Chat: a side conversation can explore a subtopic without adding all of it to the primary agent context.
